label: Week 32, 2026
recap:
This week was quiet for US AI policy activity. There was one bill movement, and it was tied to California, the only jurisdiction that saw legislative activity during the period. The record does not attach a specific policy theme to this bill, so none is named here. No federal documents were logged for the week, and no agency activity appeared in the data.

On the litigation side, there were four case updates during the week, though the underlying data does not specify which courts or subjects were involved. Taken together, the week reflects modest legislative movement concentrated in a single state, paired with a somewhat busier pace of case developments. No broader national or multi-state pattern can be drawn from these numbers alone.
